attempts.summary: Brought node1's previously-unconfigured vtnet2 (facing lan-b/node3) into service as a new OPNsense zone "optlanb" (10.60.60.1/24) with a pass-any firewall rule, addressed node3's matching eth1 (10.60.60.12/24), and added complementary routes on node2 and node3 so traffic between node3 and node2 transits node1's new zone (verified via TTL decrement and pf state table). Persisted all configuration (config.xml on node1, /etc/network/interfaces on node2/node3), then sequentially restarted all three nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery of the zone, routes, and end-to-end connectivity after each restart.
